frequency_question: What proportion of nominated high-profile officials secure a floor vote before an impending deadline once moving to the Senate floor?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations reported out of committee or brought directly to the floor for a confirmation vote; excludes nominations that stall indefinitely in committee without a discharge or floor schedule attempt.

cases.name: Amy Coney Barrett Supreme Court Nomination
Ketanji Brown Jackson Supreme Court Nomination

provenance_note: 8 cases named, 10 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 8 named; believed roughly 10 in total for extreme short-deadline high-profile cases.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier civil servants where floor votes are routinely bundled or expedited via voice vote.
skeleton: Total high-profile or contested executive nominations reaching final floor consideration stages divided by total high-profile nominations requiring Senate confirmation.
multiplier: 8 hits out of 10 comparable high-profile fast-track nomination attempts near procedural deadlines.
validity_reason: Senate confirmation rules and cloture procedures remain stable across standard congressional terms.
